capabilities: Sign in to a Proton account through the browser from settings or the command palette
Insert proton-drive:/// embeds from node UIDs (volumeId~nodeId) for files and Photos library items
Embed images, videos, PDFs, plain text and Markdown files in reading view
Resolve legacy drive.proton.me share links for My files items
Optionally persist the sign-in session across Obsidian restarts
disambiguation: Not a vault-sync or backup tool; it only embeds existing Proton Drive files in notes, it does not move vault files to Proton.
extras: README states the plugin is an early foundation and unstable because the Proton Drive SDK can change without notice; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README discloses AI-assisted development and warns that persisted sessions store unencrypted credentials in data.json.
problem: Obsidian cannot embed files stored in Proton's encrypted Drive; there is no way to resolve or render Proton Drive links inside notes.

relations.evidence: Bridge between Obsidian and Proton Drive, built on the official @protontech/drive-sdk.

summary: Proton Drive integration that signs in to a Proton account and embeds Drive images, videos, PDFs and documents in notes via stable proton-drive:/// node UID links.
